title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN THE FIREPLACE AREA!
description_en: We are selling a 2+1 apartment in the Oxhak area. The apartment is located on the 5th floor of an existing 5-storey building (with red bricks). It has a total area of ​​80.4m2 organized in a distribution corridor, a living room together with a kitchen, two bedrooms and a bathroom as well as a closed balcony. The area has all the necessary facilities nearby, such as schools/kindergartens/kindergartens/policlinics/hospitals/markets and many others. (SOLD PARTLY FURNISHED) For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
